objective: Bring the Delicate Car Parts to Fizzle Brassbolts in Shimmering Flats.

description: Now that I have what I need, give these parts to Fizzle Brassbolts.  He's been waiting a long time for them -- I'm sure he won't miss the little piece I removed from his order...
And I wouldn't bother mentioning it to him.  It was small and worthless.
progress: You have something for me? That's great! let's see it!
completion: There they are! My hydro ratchets and repeater bolts! These will do just fine. Thank you!
